steps.en: Install the beta package into a React DOM app
steps.zh: 在 React DOM 应用里安装 beta 版包

steps.en: Shape rows into series, and memoize axes that each take a getValue accessor
steps.zh: 整理成序列数组，用 useMemo 记住带 getValue 取值函数的轴配置

steps.en: Render the Chart component with those options inside a sized container
steps.zh: 在有宽高的容器里渲染 Chart 组件，传入这些配置

steps.en: Infers the scale type from your values and builds D3 scales and axes
steps.zh: 按数值推断比例尺类型，用 D3 建好比例尺和坐标轴

steps.en: Measures the container and draws SVG lines, areas or bars
steps.zh: 量出容器尺寸，画出 SVG 折线、面积或柱子

steps.en: Snaps tooltip and cursors to the nearest point via a Voronoi hit map
steps.zh: 借 Voronoi 命中图让提示框和十字线吸附到最近的点

value.en: Responsive, hoverable React charts from your own row objects without writing D3 drawing code
value.zh: 直接用你自己的行对象得到可伸缩、可悬停的 React 图表，不用手写 D3 绘图代码

sources: docs/src/pages/docs/getting-started.md (series array with data; primaryAxis/secondaryAxes with getValue: datum => datum.date; <Chart options={{ data, primaryAxis, secondaryAxes }} />)
